purpose: Draw triangle ABC with D on segment AB and E on segment AC, with segments CD and DE. DE is perpendicular to AC; draw a small right-angle square mark at E between rays E->A and E->D. Use measured pixel

text: The critic flagged one medium issue: the E label sits on the AC stroke. I'll repair by moving it above-left.

purpose: Move the E label so it does not sit on the AC stroke: place it above-left of vertex E, e.g. \node[above left] at (E) {$E$} (keep bound to coordinate E). Keep everything else unchanged.

result.summary: Produced compilable TikZ (version 2) reconstructing the figure: triangle ABC with D on AB, E on AC, segments CD and DE with a right-angle mark at E between E->A and E->D. Critic review of v2 scored 0.92 with no remaining issues; the E label was moved above-left to clear the AC stroke. Topology check passed.
